name: Ironsunder
description: Smash a plate of grown iron down on a foe's guard from above, breaking it and the arm behind it.

name: Steelhail
description: Throw a shower of heavy steel chips over the foes in front of the user.

name: Carapaceward
description: Draw a thick carapace of iron plates over the whole body and hold it against heavy blows.

name: Metalgrasp
description: Close iron bands from the ground round a foe's legs and arms and hold him there.

name: Anvil Tempest
description: Rain anvil-heavy blows on the ground and foes about the user in a storm of ringing strokes.

name: Hammered Aegis
description: Hammer a great shield of iron into being in front of the user and keep it whole through repeated blows.

name: Ruin Lance
description: Drive a long lance of iron through armor, shield and the foe behind them in a single thrust.

name: Iron Torrent
description: Pour a torrent of iron spikes at a distant foe or column of foes without pause.

name: Falling Colossus
description: Call a colossus of iron down upon a single foe, with the weight to crush a stone tower into rubble.

name: Iron Nova
description: Burst the user's stored iron outward in a blinding nova of shards.

name: Ferrous Cage
description: Close bars of iron round a powerful foe in a cage which tightens for as long as the user holds it.

name: Heaven Anvil
description: A school move of the falling iron: a single anvil of iron dropped from the height of the user's reach, whose weight and ruin scale to the user's own grade.

name: Iron Cataclysm
description: Bring down a sky of falling iron over a broad region, a ruin of the largest scale a Xiantian cultivator can bring to bear; the cast is long, the cost depletes the reserve and the destruction is that of a razed quarter of a city.

name: Bladesunder
description: Drive a blade of Core metal qi through a guard in a single sundering cut.

name: Razorveil
description: Cover the body in a veil of whirling blades that cuts whatever strikes at it.

name: Blademantle
description: Wear a mantle of overlapping blades as armor that cuts the hands of any who strike it.

name: Steelsnare
description: Throw a net of blades about a foe so that every movement cuts him against the net.

name: Blade Typhoon
description: Whirl a typhoon of blades about the user that shreds all within a wide circle.

name: Hundredfold Cut
description: Cut a hundred times in a single breath at one foe, from a hundred angles.

name: Sword Aegis
description: Raise a circle of upright swords before the user to take and break the blows of many foes.

name: Skyward Lances
description: Throw lances of blades up and over a line of foes so that they fall on each in turn.

name: Edge Calamity
description: Loose every edge the Core can draw in a single savage burst across the space before the user.

name: Steel Reckoning
description: Send a mass of blades at one foe in a way that no armor or guard can lessen, since each blade finds the one weak point.

name: Unsheathed Heaven
description: Fill the sky above a battlefield with drawn blades and hold them there before they fall.

name: Blade Requiem
description: A school move of the unsheathed blades: the whole host sings and descends together, with a reach and a toll that scale to the user's own grade.

name: Blade Apocalypse
description: Draw ten thousand blades from the Core and loose them across a wide region, a ruin of the largest scale a Core cultivator can bring to bear; the cast is long and costly and the destruction is that of a razed town.

name: Steel Extinction
description: Turn every blade in reach into one blinding wave that cuts through ground, wall and rank alike, a ruin of the scale a Core cultivator can bring to bear and one that leaves the user's reserve depleted.

name: Adamantward
description: Wrap the body in adamant metal drawn from the divine reserve and hold it against heavy blows.

name: Worldiron
description: Call the iron beneath the ground to rise and bind a foe in the grip of the world itself.

name: Divinecut
description: Cut with a divine edge that bites through guard and armor in a single stroke.

name: Steelwrath
description: Strike the ground so that an angry ring of steel spikes surges out about the user.

name: Adamant Tempest
description: Whirl adamant shards in a storm that levels all in a wide circle about the user.

name: Celestial Anvil
description: Bring down an anvil of divine metal on a single foe with a heaven-shaking blow.

name: Skysteel Aegis
description: Raise a shield of skysteel above the user that turns even divine blows.

name: Divine Lance
description: Throw a lance of pure divine metal that pierces everything in a line from the user to the horizon.

name: Worldsteel Blow
description: Strike a foe with the full weight of the iron of the world gathered behind a single fist.

name: Adamant Judgment
description: Pass a verdict of adamant metal on one foe that no guard or armor can lessen.

name: Celestial Chains
description: Cast chains of divine metal from the sky round a foe of great power and hold him there.

name: Divine Hammer
description: A school move of the divine canon: the hammer-blow of the whole adamant reserve, whose weight scales to the user's own grade.

name: Skysteel Requiem
description: A school move of the divine canon: a slow storm of skysteel falling in measured strokes, whose reach scales to the user's own grade.

name: Final Anvil
description: Raise a divine anvil and drop it as the last blow on a single foe or fortress, a ruin of the largest scale a divine cultivator can bring to bear; the cast is long and the destruction is that of a citadel levelled to its foundations.

name: Adamant Annihilation
description: Turn the whole divine reserve into adamant wave after wave, the largest destruction a divine cultivator can wield, razing a wide region to bare rock and leaving the user spent.
